description: This file defines the EmployeeCustomFieldAPI class, which provides API endpoints for listing and updating custom fields associated with employees within the orangehrm project. It includes methods to retrieve custom fields for a specific employee, update their values, and handle validation and permissions.

classes.name: EmployeeCustomFieldAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing employee custom fields, including listing and updating custom field values for specific employees.

methods.name: getCustomFieldService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of CustomFieldService.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch custom fields of a specific employee, with optional screen filtering.

methods.name: getEmployeeCustomFieldsByFieldNumbers
methods.description: Constructs an associative array of custom field values for an employee given a list of field numbers.

methods.name: extractFieldNumbersFromCustomFields
methods.description: Extracts field numbers from an array of CustomField objects.

methods.name: getUrlParams
methods.description: Retrieves employee number and screen name from request URL parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the GET endpoint.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for employee number parameter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update custom fields for a specific employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the update operation.

methods.name: getCustomFieldsParamsRules
methods.description: Generates validation rules for each configurable custom field parameter.
